title: VIXEN configure needs a manual worktree FetchContent cache setting
body: The prescribed VIXEN configure requires explicitly setting VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE to <worktree>/.tmp/fetch. This is worktree provisioning that could be supplied by the configure preset so callers need no manual environment override. Exact configure used: VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=/home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/typedvals/VIXEN/.tmp/fetch nice -n 10 cmake --preset vixen-wsl -DYEROKET_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy -DVIXEN_SCHEMA_CATALOG=/home/liory/projects/undertow/core/src/Undertow.Authoring/Schema/schemas.json

title: VIXEN codegen repeats the typed kernel source list
body: To make the typed recipe operations reach all generated backends, I added the TypedRecipeValueKernels.cs source to three codegen invocations with --recipe-kernels-extra in VIXEN/codegen/CMakeLists.txt. The source declaration is made once in the kernel, but the consumer must manually repeat source-list wiring for RecipeSimd, SDF kernels, and opcode metadata. Consolidate kernel discovery so one declaration or manifest feeds all emitters.

title: VIXEN kernel pin changes leave a stale CMake cache value
body: After changing YEROKET_KERNEL_SHA in VIXEN/codegen/CMakeLists.txt, the existing build/wsl/CMakeCache.txt retained the base SHA 769fb232bd861a7e57fe73fd12b0aed716c3adde. The first queued cmake --build ../build/wsl -j8 therefore compiled against old generated recipe tables and failed on the new typed opcodes. Recovery reconfigured with VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=/home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/typedvals/VIXEN/.tmp/fetch cmake --preset vixen-wsl -DYEROKET_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy -DVIXEN_SCHEMA_CATALOG=/home/liory/projects/undertow/core/src/Undertow.Authoring/Schema/schemas.json -DYEROKET_KERNEL_SHA=4171060ade411b2f0f0bcf9bdeeaef0c82fc0eb3. Make pin changes refresh or invalidate the cached CMake value so a stale snapshot cannot silently build.

title: Nested VIXEN builds need the parent queue launcher path
body: From the VIXEN/ directory, the first required queued build invocation bash tools/with-test-lock.sh --agent typedvals --resource build --label typedvals:vixen-final-build -- nice -n 10 cmake --build ../build/wsl --target all test_recipe_bake test_recipe_bake_center test_recipe_baker test_recipe_boot_ingest test_recipe_bounds test_recipe_bucket_data_cacher test_recipe_bucketed_indirect_dispatch test_recipe_bucketing_perf test_recipe_codegen test_recipe_codegen_glsl test_recipe_composition test_recipe_container_parity test_recipe_content_cacher test_recipe_content_hash test_recipe_declared_position_render test_recipe_eval_parity test_recipe_glsl_numerical_parity test_recipe_ingest test_recipe_instance_bucketing test_recipe_kernel_glsl_roundtrip test_recipe_manifest test_recipe_multi_bucket_compositing test_recipe_nested_invocation test_recipe_occupancy test_recipe_pack_loader test_recipe_parity_fixture_export test_recipe_pool_render test_recipe_registry test_recipe_simd_parity test_sdf_bake test_sdf_core_glsl test_sdf_recipes -j8 exited 127 because the wrapper is one directory above VIXEN/. Retrying the exact payload through bash ../tools/with-test-lock.sh succeeded. Document or resolve the worktree-root wrapper path from nested build directories.
